title: Floodmark Gate
description: A Romanesque limestone gate with three concentric orders, battered ashlar piers and a paved ford threshold.

review.notes: Round 3 (final): approved. The weathering now reads at full size: dark rain streaks run down from under the impost blocks and the keystone, and the pier feet have a damp green-grey band with lichen and turf (hero, closeup_upper, closeup_base). Structure, joints and threshold were already at 8. Polish, not blocking: the worn tread is still hard to see on the threshold; darken the central walking line slightly.
